episodeTitle.zh: 布莱恩·切斯基的新策略手册

guestBioOfficial.en: Brian Chesky is the co-founder and CEO of Airbnb. Under Brian’s leadership, Airbnb has grown into a community of over 4 million hosts who have welcomed more than 1.5 billion guests across over 220 countries and regions. I had the privilege of working under his leadership, so it is a great honor to have him on the show. We discuss: • How Airbnb has shifted their thinking on product management
guestBioOfficial.zh: 布莱恩·切斯基是Airbnb的联合创始人兼首席执行官。在布莱恩的领导下，Airbnb已发展成为一个由400多万房东组成的社区，他们在220多个国家和地区接待了超过15亿名客人。我有幸在他的领导下工作，所以很荣幸能邀请他参加节目。我们讨论： • Airbnb如何转变了他们对产品管理的思维方式

title.zh: 布莱恩·切斯基的新策略手册

summary.en: Brian explains his controversial shift in how Airbnb runs product management—staying close to every design and feature with a single company-wide roadmap—and distinguishes “being in the details” from micromanagement. He describes moving away from paid growth channels toward building the best product and letting word of mouth drive growth. The conversation also covers how he finds balance and avoids burnout while continuing to learn as a leader.
summary.zh: Brian 解释了他引发争议的产品管理改革——贴近每一个设计与功能，并采用全公司单一路线图——并区分了“深入细节”与微观管理。他描述了如何摆脱付费增长渠道，转而打造最好的产品、让口碑驱动增长。对话还涵盖他作为领导者如何寻找平衡、避免倦怠并持续学习。
